description_en: Queries IPv6 egress-only rules that you created
description_zh: 查询创建的仅主动出规则
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ipv6-egress-only-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-bp1rhhs9zjlxukc5e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIpv6EgressOnlyRules

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 gateway
parameters.name: ipv6_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 egress-only rule to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查看的仅主动出规则ID
parameters.name: ipv6_egress_only_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance for which you want to configure an IPv6 egress-only rule. Valid values:

IPv6Address (default): The instance is a single IPv6 address.
IPv6Prefix: The instance is an IPv6 CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
需要设置仅主动出规则的实例类型，取值：

IPv6Address（默认值）：代表当前实例是单个 IPv6 IP。
IPv6Prefix：代表当前实例是 IPv6 Cidr
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 address for which an IPv6 egress-only rule is configured
parameters.help_zh: 设置了仅主动出规则的IPv6地址的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
